news.title:
AU Small Finance Bank's Q4 net profit surged 65% YoY to ₹831 crore, driven by reduced provisions and improved asset quality. Gross NPA fell to 2.03%.
Net interest income rose 23.3% YoY to ₹2,582.3 crore. Deposits grew 23% YoY; CASA deposits increased 20%. Shares closed at ₹1,043.45, down 2.1%.
news.summary:
AU Small Finance Bank's Q4 net profit surged 65% YoY to ₹831 crore, driven by reduced provisions and improved asset quality. Gross NPA fell to 2.03%.
Net interest income rose 23.3% YoY to ₹2,582.3 crore. Deposits grew 23% YoY; CASA deposits increased 20%. Shares closed at ₹1,043.45, down 2.1%.
